2115508136450662875.en_summary: @MarketRebels (reposted from @petenajarian) says $ENPH fell roughly 14% to 20% after adjusted EPS of $0.41 missed estimates near $0.51 and it guided Q4 revenue to $225 to $255 million versus about $300 million expected, blaming soft U.S. home solar demand, higher interest rates and expiring tax credits. $SEDG slid about 9% to 10% in sympathy. An image is attached; its content is not described here.
2115508136450662875.zh_summary: @MarketRebels（轉發自 @petenajarian）表示 $ENPH 下跌約 14% 至 20%，經調整每股盈利 0.41 美元，遜於市場預期的約 0.51 美元，並預計第四季收入僅 2.25 億至 2.55 億美元，市場預期約 3 億美元，公司歸咎於美國家用太陽能需求疲弱、利率上升及稅務優惠到期。$SEDG 受拖累下跌約 9% 至 10%。附上一張圖片，內容未作描述。
